decisions.quote: For the second replication, we observed directional effects consistent with DiMaggio et al. except in the case of the proportion of residents over 65.
decisions.reason: The paper reports mixed comparisons across its direct and conceptual replications: several neighborhood-level predictors agreed in direction and fell within the original 95% credible intervals in the second direct replication, while the age over 65 predictor disagreed and the primary Black/African American association did not replicate in the conceptual replication.
